reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR code, and that is exactly what anyone can print. No NSF or USP seal, no reviews, a brand I have never heard of, so I stay with Thorne or Pure Encapsulations.
objection: A new brand with zero reviews and no third-party seal like NSF or USP. A QR code to their own batch report is not the same as a certification I can verify.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, or a few hundred verified reviews from people who have taken it for a while.
